falseSynonyms.zh: 政府不等於任何主管機構 government 指整體政府；authority 可以只是政府內一個具體機構。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The government sets national policy. A regulatory authority may oversee one particular sector.

falseSynonyms.zh: 官員不等於機構 official 常指一名官員，也可作形容詞；authority 在這裡指機構本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An official works for the authority. The authority is the organization.

falseSynonyms.zh: 警察不等於所有主管機構 police 只是執法機構的一種，不能泛指任何 authority。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The police investigate crimes. Other authorities regulate transport, finance, health, or licensing.

falseSynonyms.zh: 公司不等於主管機構 company 是商業組織；authority 通常具有公共、法定或監管權力。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A company operates a business. An authority may regulate that business.

falseSynonyms.zh: 組織不一定是官方機構 organization 範圍很廣，可以是私人、慈善或商業組織，未必有官方權力。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Every authority is an organization, but not every organization is an authority.

falseSynonyms.zh: 管理層不等於主管機構 management 指負責管理某公司的管理人員；不等於公共或法定 authority。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Company management makes internal decisions. A regulator may oversee the company externally.

falseSynonyms.zh: 單數與複數不同 authority 可指一個機構；authorities 常泛指多個官方機構或當局。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The authority issued a licence. The authorities launched a joint investigation.

falseSynonyms.zh: 形容詞與名詞不同 authorized 表示獲准的；authority 是名詞，可指權力或主管機構。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Only authorized staff may enter. The authority controls access.
